title: Prismatic
wikitext: '''Prismatic''' is a [[gem tag]]. This tag applies to skills which choose a random element between [[Fire]], [[Cold]], and [[Lightning]] to deal damage with. This behaviour can be modified through [[Combat Focus]] jewels. ==Mechanics== Prismatic skills without the Fire, Cold, or Lightning gem tags, such as {{il|Summon Skeletons of Mages}}, are not considered Elemental skills for the purpose of stats like {{psl|Disorienting Display}}'s {{c|mod|#% chance to Blind nearby Enemies when you use an Elemental Skill}}, but can be considered Elemental in the context of modifiers like {{il|Svalinn}} or {{il|Mjölner}}'s {{c|mod|Trigger a Socketed Elemental/Lightning Spell...}} due to [[minion]] properties. ==Skills== ===Skill gems=== There are {{Drop enabled gem count|where=items.class_id="Active Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Prismatic"}} [[skill gems]] with the [[:Category:Prismatic (gem tag)|Prismatic]] [[gem tag]]: {{Drop enabled gem table |where=items.class_id="Active Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Prismatic" }} ===Non-gem skills=== The following player-usable skills have the internal RandomElement active skill type, but are not granted by active skill gems. They can be adjusted by effects such as [[Combat Focus]]: {| class="wikitable" ! Skill ! Source |- | {{sl|id=PrismaticBurst}} | Granted by {{il|Prismatic Burst Support}} |- | {{sl|id=SummonElementalRelic}} | Granted by [[Unwavering Crusade]] |} ===Support gems=== There are {{Drop enabled gem count|where=items.class_id="Support Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Prismatic"}} [[support gems]] with the [[:Category:Prismatic (gem tag)|Prismatic]] [[gem tag]]: {{Drop enabled gem table |where=items.class_id="Support Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Prismatic" }} ==Unique items== The following [[unique items]] are related to Prismatic skills: {{Item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= items.stat_text LIKE "%Prismatic%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Megalomaniac%" AND items.rarity_id = "Unique" AND items.name != "The Hungry Loop" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Introduced to the game as a gem tag. }} {{Version history table end}} [[Category:Gem tag mechanics]] [[Category:Gem tags]]
